description: Scan only files that have changed since a given git ref (branch, commit, or HEAD~N). Ideal for PR checks, pre-push hooks, and incremental CI. Diff-aware by default: returns only findings on newly-added lines (set diff_aware:false for whole changed files).

base.description: Git ref to diff against (e.g. 'main', 'HEAD~3', commit SHA)

diff_aware.description: Report only newly-introduced findings on added lines (true, default) vs. all findings in changed files (false)

name: scan_changed_files
